title: HtmlSpan
responsibility: Renders the native span element without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: HtmlSpan.children
inputs.description: Optional content within the native span element; native HTML content rules still apply. Defaults to JavaScript undefined (no child snippet).

outputs.name: HtmlSpan
outputs.description: The actual native span element, with forwarded attributes and content and no additional wrapper. States: long: The native span element retains long caller content in its normal semantic context.

errors.name: Caller content or event error
errors.description: Supplied event handlers and rendered child snippets may throw; the atom does not catch their errors. Void elements ignore the child snippet.
